systems.name: BoxDropSys
systems.summary: init only: creates `count` box (or capsule) RigidBody entities on a jittered centered grid above the ground with the world RNG; tick is a no-op.

systems.name: ChunkManagerSys
systems.summary: Creates ChunkC entities within view_distance of the desktop Camera and the VR rig, tags chunks beyond view_distance + one chunk with ChunkDestroying.

systems.name: ChunkGeneratorSys
systems.summary: Generates chunk densities with TerrainGenerator on the taskflow executor (at most 16 jobs, nearest first; all at once and synchronously in deterministic runs) and tags the results.

systems.name: SphereControlSys
systems.summary: Before PhysicsStep: on the first tick of a decision window runs the pending episode reset and converts AgentIO::action into a world torque; every tick applies the held torque to the sphere's Jolt body.

systems.name: SphereTaskSys
systems.summary: After PhysicsStep: accumulates the per-tick reward against the decision target, drifts the live target toward its goal, ends and parks the episode when out of bounds or fallen.

systems.name: SphereObserveSys
systems.summary: Observe phase: handles a host RESET or publishes the window's reward / done / stats into AgentIO, then writes the 16-float observation of the live target.

systems.name: TrainerActionsSys
systems.summary: Empty Act-phase placeholder of training templates: the training host writes AgentIO::action directly; scenes replace it with Policy or SphereHeuristic.

systems.name: SphereHeuristicSys
systems.summary: Act phase: writes sphereHeuristic(observation) (gain 1) into AgentIO::action when the observation has 16 floats.

systems.name: SystemSet
systems.lane: owns the Pre / Post / Fixed lanes; fixed_tick called by World::tick
systems.summary: Ordered lists of systems (Pre, Post, Fixed lanes); fixed_tick gates Every/Act systems on the world's Parked flag and runs Act/Observe systems on the first/last tick of the decision window.

components.name: Transform
components.summary: Position, rotation and scale of an entity in world space.
components.description: World-space pose (Y up, -Z forward) of an entity; matrix() returns T * R * S. Required next to RigidBody (PhysicsSys / PhysicsStepSys write it for dynamic bodies, read it for kinematic ones) and ModelRenderable / ModelRef. Created from scene JSON (`Transform` key, registered in src/scene/system_registry.cpp), by BoxDropSys::init, and by host-side view systems (BoxRing, BoxThrower, VRControl hands, WorldView proxies, spawn helpers). resetSphereEpisode writes it on respawn.
components.scene_json: "Transform": { "position": [x, y, z], "rotation": [x, y, z, w], "scale": [x, y, z] } (all optional; unknown keys rejected)

fields.name: scale
fields.desc: applied last in matrix(); RigidBody::half_extent already includes it

components.name: RigidBody
components.summary: A Jolt body (box, sphere or capsule; static, dynamic or kinematic) attached to the entity's Transform.
components.description: Request for a Jolt body: RigidBodySys creates it on its first tick after the component appears (needs a Transform) and stores the BodyID in `body`; destroying the entity or removing the component destroys the body (on_destroy hook). Dynamic bodies are simulated and their Transform written back (interpolated through PhysicsPose); kinematic ones follow their Transform; static ones never move. Units are world units (metres in the agent worlds), kg. Created from scene JSON (`RigidBody` key), by BoxDropSys::init and by host view systems (BoxRing, BoxThrower, VRControl hands). The sphere agent's SphereControl / SphereTask / SphereObserve read `body` and `half_extent`.
components.scene_json: "RigidBody": { "motion": "static|dynamic|kinematic", "shape": "box|sphere|capsule", "half_extent", "offset", "friction", "restitution", "angular_damping", "mass", "initial_velocity", "initial_angular_velocity" } (all optional; unknown keys and enum values rejected)

fields.name: half_extent
fields.desc: world units, scale included; sphere radius = x; capsule radius = x, cylinder half-height = y (local Y)

fields.name: offset
fields.desc: shape centre relative to the Transform position, local space

fields.name: mass
fields.desc: kg, inertia scaled to it; 0 = Jolt's density of 1000 kg/m^3

fields.name: body
fields.desc: JPH::BodyID index+sequence, assigned by RigidBodySys; created() is body != 0xffffffff

components.name: Ground
components.summary: A flat static Jolt box whose top face is at top_y, centred on the origin in XZ.
components.description: Flat ground of the test worlds (physics.md): RigidBodySys creates a static box of `size` full extents on the STATIC layer at (0, top_y - size.y/2, 0) in init (so world systems can place bodies on it in their init) and again in every tick for new ones; the on_destroy hook removes it. Scene JSON only (scene entities exist in worlds), usually through the `ground_flat` prefab; WorldView draws it.

components.name: HeightField
components.summary: Static Jolt height field of rolling hills, a sum of random plane waves, centred on the origin.
components.description: Rolling-hills ground of sphere_roll_hills: RigidBodySys draws `waves` plane waves into wave_list (from `seed`, or one draw of WorldRng when 0) and creates a static height field of samples x samples points spaced `spacing` on the STATIC layer, together with the grounds. height(x, z) is the smooth surface (defined in src/physics/height_field.cpp); size() = (samples - 1) * spacing. Scene JSON only.

fields.name: wavelength
fields.desc: log-uniform range of the wavelengths, metres

fields.name: wave_slope
fields.desc: steepest slope of each wave (amplitude x wavenumber)

fields.name: seed
fields.desc: 0 = one draw of the world RNG

fields.name: wave_list
fields.type: std::vector<HeightField::Wave {vec2 k; float amplitude; float phase}>

components.name: PhysicsStats
components.summary: Physics counters and timings shown by the debug menu.
components.description: Context variable created on demand by physicsStats(reg) (src/physics/physics_sys.cpp), first called from RigidBodySys::preinit; PhysicsSys and TerrainCollidersSys fill it each frame on the host registry; DebugMenuSys displays it.

components.name: ModelRef
components.summary: A glTF path and tint to draw at the entity's Transform.
components.description: Scene-level model reference by path under resources/; headless runs ignore it. In the current code only WorldViewSys reads it, and only its `color` (the mesh is chosen from RigidBody::shape); nothing resolves `path` into a ModelRenderable yet. Created from scene JSON and by BoxDropSys::init (box: models/primitives/box.gltf; capsule: models/primitives/capsule, a path with no file under resources/).

fields.name: path
fields.desc: model path under resources/, required in JSON

components.name: Camera
components.summary: Free-flying desktop camera: position, yaw, pitch and projection parameters.
components.description: Host context variable emplaced by PlayerControlSys::preinit and driven by it (FixedCamera, SphereView, RollerPlayer also write it). yaw 0 looks toward -Z; forward() / right() / getView() derive from position, yaw, pitch; getProjection(aspect) is Vulkan clip space (depth 0..1, Y flipped). Read by ClassicRender, TerrainSys, ChunkManagerSys (load centre) and ChunkGeneratorSys (priority centre), DebugMenu, Capture.

components.name: FrameClock
components.summary: Frame delta, accumulated time and frame number of the dynamical frame loop.
components.description: Host context variable emplaced in the Game constructor (src/view/game.cpp) and advanced by the frame loop before the systems tick (dt, time += dt, frame++). With RunArgs::fixed_frame_dt, dt is fixed and time = frame * dt, so nothing reads the wall clock. Read by the Renderer (shader time) and capture/probe code.

components.name: RenderSettings
components.summary: Runtime toggles of the scene passes and the grass shader parameters.
components.description: Host context variable emplaced by the Renderer constructor; DebugMenuSys edits it; TerrainPass, GrassPass and ModelPass read it (find) to skip drawing and to fill the grass parameters.

components.name: VRRig
components.summary: Placement of the OpenXR stage space (play area) in the world.
components.description: Host context variable emplaced by the VRRender constructor. VRControlSys moves and turns it (left stick locomotion only while stick_locomotion), RollerPlayer (VRRoller) drives it and clears stick_locomotion. transform() = translate(position) * rotateY(yaw). ChunkManagerSys uses position as a load centre while VRInput::session_running.

fields.name: position
fields.desc: world position of the stage origin

fields.name: stick_locomotion
fields.desc: VRControl moves the rig with the left stick; off when a system drives it

components.name: VRInput
components.summary: Head and controller poses and buttons, in stage space, written each frame by the VR renderer.
components.description: Host context variable emplaced by VRActions (src/renderer/vr_render/vr_input.cpp; also registered when VR is disabled) and written after xrWaitFrame. Holds the head VRPose and two Hand entries (index VRInput::left = 0, VRInput::right = 1) with pose, linear velocity (stage space, m/s), trigger/grip values, thumbstick and rising-edge flags. Read by VRControlSys, RollerPlayer, DebugMenu, VRRender, ChunkManagerSys (session_running).

fields.name: head
fields.type: VRPose {bool valid; vec3 position; quat rotation}

fields.name: hands[2].primary
fields.desc: A (right) / X (left) on Touch, A on Index

components.name: Parked
components.summary: World flag: the agent's episode ended mid-window and the world waits for the Observe phase.
components.description: World context variable emplaced by the World constructor (src/scene/world.cpp). While value is true, SystemSet::fixed_tick skips the Every and Act systems and runs only the Observe systems (simulation.md, parking). The sphere agent sets it in SphereTaskSys when the sphere leaves the bounds or falls, and clears it in SphereObserveSys at the end of the episode and in resetSphereEpisode. fixed_observe_only ignores it.

components.name: AgentIO
components.summary: The world's agent as the training host sees it: behaviour, sizes, action in, observation / reward / done / stats out.
components.description: World context variable, one agent per world. Created on demand by agentIO(reg) (find or emplace), first by SphereControlSys::preinit; SphereControlSys::init calls configure(behavior, 16, 3), which sets sensor_name = "VectorSensor_size<obs>" and zero-fills action and observation. The host (WorldsEnvironment, PolicySys, SphereHeuristicSys, tests) writes `action` and `reset_requested` between windows; SphereObserveSys writes observation, reward, done, truncated and stats in the Observe phase; resetSphereEpisode zeroes action and clears reward / done / truncated / stats.

fields.name: action
fields.desc: host to world: the decision for the coming window

fields.name: reset_requested
fields.desc: host to world: start a new episode at the next Observe phase (RESET)

fields.name: observation
fields.desc: world to host, written by the Observe phase

fields.name: reward
fields.desc: mean per-tick reward over the window that just ended

fields.name: done
fields.desc: the episode ended with this observation

fields.name: truncated
fields.desc: ended by a limit (time, bounds), not a terminal state

fields.name: stats
fields.desc: this window's values, averaged by the host

components.name: SphereAgent
components.summary: The sphere_roll agent next to the sphere's Transform and RigidBody: task settings and episode state.
components.description: Exactly one entity per world is expected to carry SphereAgent + Transform + RigidBody (sphere shape; half_extent.x is the radius); the systems use the first one of the view. Created from scene JSON (`SphereAgent` key, registered by registerSphereRoller with validation). The settings come from JSON; the episode state is written by resetSphereEpisode, SphereControlSys, SphereTaskSys and SphereObserveSys, and by steerSphere (RollerPlayer: VRRoller / DesktopRoller). The serializer writes back only the settings.
components.scene_json: "SphereAgent": { "behavior", "max_torque", "speed_range", "stop_chance", "turn_rate", "acceleration", "goal_interval", "max_goal_turn", "home_radius", "bounds", "fall_depth", "spawn_radius", "spawn_spacing", "stagger", "reward_scale", "probe_distance", "max_decisions", "steered" } (validated: behavior non-empty, max_decisions >= 1, 0 <= speed_range.x <= speed_range.y, 0 < goal_interval.x <= goal_interval.y, reward_scale > 0)

fields.name: behavior
fields.desc: trainer behaviour name; must be non-empty

fields.name: max_torque
fields.desc: N m for an action component of 1

fields.name: stop_chance
fields.desc: probability that a drawn target speed is 0

fields.name: turn_rate
fields.desc: rad/s of the target heading toward its goal

fields.name: acceleration
fields.desc: m/s^2 of the target speed toward its goal

fields.name: goal_interval
fields.desc: seconds between goal draws; 0 < min <= max

fields.name: max_goal_turn
fields.desc: rad: new goal heading within this of the current heading

fields.name: home_radius
fields.desc: beyond it from home, new goals point back (+-45 deg); 0 off

fields.name: bounds
fields.desc: |x| or |z| beyond it truncates the episode; 0 off

fields.name: fall_depth
fields.desc: this far below home truncates the episode

fields.name: spawn_radius
fields.desc: spawn points uniform in a disc of this radius around the spawn centre

fields.name: stagger
fields.desc: on RESET start at a random decision count in [0, max_decisions)

fields.name: reward_scale
fields.desc: r = exp(-|v_xz - v*| / reward_scale), m/s; must be > 0

fields.name: probe_distance
fields.desc: horizontal distance of the look-ahead ground normals, m

fields.name: steered
fields.desc: a player sets the goal (steerSphere): no goal draws, no time limit

fields.name: heading
fields.desc: episode state: live target heading, rad (direction (cos h, 0, sin h))

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: episode state: live target speed, m/s

fields.name: goal_heading
fields.desc: episode state: heading the target turns toward

fields.name: goal_speed
fields.desc: episode state: speed the target accelerates toward

fields.name: goal_timer
fields.desc: episode state: seconds until the next goal draw

fields.name: decision_target
fields.desc: episode state: target velocity of the last observation (rewards use it)

fields.name: decision_heading
fields.desc: episode state: heading of the last observation (frame of the action torque)

fields.name: has_decision
fields.desc: episode state: an observation was sent this episode and the episode has not ended

fields.name: torque
fields.desc: episode state: world torque held over the window, N m

fields.name: reward_sum
fields.desc: episode state: sum of per-tick rewards this window

fields.name: error_sum
fields.desc: episode state: sum of |v_xz - target| this window

fields.name: reward_ticks
fields.desc: episode state: ticks summed this window

fields.name: decisions
fields.desc: episode state: observations sent this episode

fields.name: ended
fields.desc: episode state: episode over (time limit or out of bounds)

fields.name: out_of_bounds
fields.desc: episode state: ended by bounds / fall

fields.name: pending_reset
fields.desc: episode state: terminal observation sent, reset at the next window

components.name: ChunkC
components.summary: A marching cubes chunk at integer chunk coordinates.
components.description: Created by ChunkManagerSys on a new entity (and registered in ChunkMap) for every chunk whose centre is within view_distance of a load centre. A chunk covers chunk::length = 256 world units per side (64 cubes of 4 units); origin() = pos * 256, center() = origin + 128. TerrainSys destroys the entity once it is tagged ChunkDestroying and not ChunkGenerating.

components.name: ChunkVolume
components.summary: The 67^3 density samples of a chunk that crosses the surface.
components.description: Emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::collect when the generated chunk has both solid (> 0) and empty (<= 0) samples. chunk::num_values = 67^3 floats, layout [x][z][y] (chunk::index), sample (x, y, z) at chunk::samplePosition(pos, x, y, z) (one-sample border). Read by TerrainSys (upload for GPU meshing) and TerrainColliders (CPU colliders).

components.name: ChunkEmpty
components.summary: Marks a chunk whose samples are all on the same side of the surface, with their mean.
components.description: Emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::collect instead of ChunkVolume when no surface crosses the chunk (all samples > 0 or all <= 0). TerrainColliders treats a cell inside such a chunk as having no surface (no collider), whatever the sign; nothing outside src/logic reads `mean`.

fields.name: mean
fields.desc: mean density of the chunk's samples

components.name: ChunkGenerating
components.summary: Chunk density is being computed on a worker thread.
components.description: Emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::tick when it starts a job, removed by ChunkGeneratorSys::collect when the job is done. TerrainSys does not destroy ChunkDestroying chunks that still have it.

components.name: ChunkGenerated
components.summary: Chunk densities are ready: ChunkVolume or ChunkEmpty is present.
components.description: Emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::collect. Excludes the chunk from further generation; counted by DebugMenu and Capture.

components.name: ChunkMeshPending
components.summary: Chunk waits for a marching cubes dispatch.
components.description: Emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::collect next to ChunkVolume; removed by TerrainSys once it has recorded the chunk's compute dispatch.

components.name: ChunkDestroying
components.summary: Chunk is beyond the unload distance and will be destroyed once no worker uses it.
components.description: Emplaced (emplace_or_replace) by ChunkManagerSys when the chunk's centre is farther than view_distance + chunk::length from every load centre; the chunk is removed from ChunkMap at the same time. TerrainSys destroys the entity (and recycles its GPU slot) once it is not ChunkGenerating. ChunkGeneratorSys never starts a job for it.

components.name: ChunkMap
components.summary: Chunk coordinates to chunk entity, for the live (not unloading) chunks.
components.description: Host context variable emplaced by ChunkManagerSys::preinit; ChunkManagerSys inserts new chunks and erases unloaded ones. get(pos) returns entt::null when absent. TerrainColliders reads loaded densities through it (falls back to TerrainGenerator::sample otherwise). Keyed with IVec3Hash.

components.name: std::shared_ptr<TerrainGenerator>
components.summary: Shared density function of the marching cubes world (FastNoise2 heightfield plus 3D overhang noise).
components.description: Context variable holding a shared TerrainGenerator, safe to call from several threads. Host: emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::preinit (default seed 1337); worlds: emplaced by WorldTerrainSys::preinit with its `seed` param. EnTT's ctx().emplace keeps an existing value, so the first emplacer wins. Density at world height y: base_level + height_amplitude * fbm2D(x, z) - y + overhang_amplitude * fbm3D; > 0 is solid. Used by ChunkGeneratorSys jobs, TerrainColliders (creates its own when absent), PlayerControl, VRControl and base scene systems (surfaceHeight).

fields.name: height_frequency
fields.desc: per world unit (5 octaves FBm, gain 0.5, lacunarity 2)

components.name: Settings
components.summary: User settings loaded from ./config.6.json and overridden by key=value arguments.
components.description: Host context variable emplaced in the Game constructor (dynamical only) as Settings(argc, argv): load() reads DYNAMICAL_CONFIG_FILE (DYNAMICAL_CONFIG_DIR "config.6.json", default ./config.6.json) with cereal JSON if it exists and always rewrites it, then argument_override applies key=value arguments (window_width, window_height, fullscreen, fps_max, username, server_side, client_side, vr_mode, view_distance; spectator_mode cannot be overridden; booleans are true only for the string "true"). Game forces vr_mode = 0 when the scene's renderer has vr false. Read by Windu, VRContext, DebugMenu, ChunkManagerSys (view_distance, with Settings::default_view_distance = 768 when absent).

fields.name: vr_mode
fields.desc: 0 desktop only, 1 VR alongside the desktop when a headset is available

fields.name: view_distance
fields.desc: chunks load within this distance of the cameras, world units
